usage: The word 兄弟 (hing1 dai6) refers to male siblings, specifically brothers.
It can be used to talk about biological brothers or close male friends like brothers.
In sentences, 兄弟 can be the subject or object, e.g., “My brothers are at home.”
You can use it in plural or singular, but usually it means more than one brother together.
It can also imply brotherhood or strong male friendship beyond blood relations.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 loeng5 go3 hing1 dai6.
keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 hing1 dai6.
ngo5 tung4 hing1 dai6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 daa2 bo1.
examples.meaning: I go play ball with my brothers.

examples.jyutping: hing1 dai6 zi1 gaan1 jiu3 wu6 soeng1 bong1 mong4.
